findings.highlight: Saber told me to listen to my senses, and they are screaming at me to head back to the roof if I want to live.
findings.evidenceJa: 命が惜しいのなら、一秒でも早く屋上に戻れと、セイバーに鍛えられた感覚が告げていた。
findings.governingReading: His Saber-trained senses order immediate return before he thinks through the blood pool.
findings.explanation: Senses trained by Saber become a remembered instruction to listen to them.
